Yes — damaged items are handled differently from normal returns.
Normal returns: Once an order has been delivered, returns are generally not accepted for change of mind or taste preferences. 
Damaged items: These are treated as a shipment issue. You can report it within 7 days of delivery and provide:
• Order number
• Description of the issue
• Photos of the damaged item and the packaging
You should also keep the item in the condition you received it while it’s reviewed. 
So in short: normal returns are limited after delivery, but damage reports are reviewed separately and may be eligible for a resolution after verification.
